sents.zh: 元朝的时候，中国有很多新的吃的。
sents.en: In the Yuan dynasty there were many new things to eat in China.
People in the north loved lamb.

sents.zh: 奶茶又白又热，天冷的时候喝很好。
sents.en: Milk tea is white and hot, and good to drink when it is cold.

sents.zh: 从西边来的商人带来了新东西。
sents.en: Merchants from the west brought new things.

sents.zh: 有的东西很香，可以放在肉里。
sents.en: Some of them were fragrant and could be put in meat.

sents.zh: 南方的人还是爱吃米和鱼。
sents.en: People in the south still loved rice and fish.

sents.zh: 一个国家里有很多种饭。
sents.en: In one country there were many kinds of food.

sents.zh: 马可·波罗也写下了他吃过的东西。
sents.en: Marco Polo wrote down what he had eaten too.

sents.zh: 他说，那些东西他家里没有。
sents.en: He said there was nothing like it at home.
